answer: In an agent economy a non-parallelizable shared context acts as a meadow of mutual history that each participant must continuously cultivate. Honest agents keep an unbroken inlet of peer-verified interactions whose state is sealed by onyx-hard commitments that cannot be cheaply forked. An attacker who spins up many fake identities must independently grow and maintain a distinct verified history for every clone, paying rising storage, latency and attestation costs that quickly exceed any extractable reward.
